enchantments.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Greater Vorpal: Passive: +0.5[W] damage dice.On Vorpal Hit: If your target has fewer than 2000 Hit Points, they are instantly slain. If your target has above 2000 Hit Points, they take 200 damage.
Doublestrike 14%: Passive: 14% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Hemorrhaging: This weapon is viciously sharp and will do an additional 2 to 16 damage to targets that are vulnerable to bleeding.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
